entries.reason: These mutators require additional tool/profile/option contracts, or the tested body configuration is rejected by the runtime.
entries.evidence: PK_BODY_reverse_orientation is covered for a valid sheet body; boolean, offset, thicken and sweep still require dedicated tool/profile contracts.
entries.recheckWhen: A dedicated mutator work package supplies valid tool bodies, options, and error-contract cases.

entries.reason: Removing a standalone body from parents is rejected; the operation requires an owning assembly/compound parent.
entries.evidence: PK_BODY_remove_from_parents on a valid standalone solid block returned error 914; no fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A parent-owned body case is available for the lifecycle operation.

entries.reason: The tested wire edge does not accept an explicit precision update under the current runtime tolerance policy.
entries.evidence: PK_EDGE_set_precision on a finite line edge returned error 96; no replacement edge or fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A wire edge with a documented precision-edit contract is available.

entries.reason: The checked-in runtime rejects reversing the face of the generated sheet body under the default face-reverse options.
entries.evidence: PK_FACE_reverse returned error 10 for the sole face of body.sheet.rectangle.typical; the body-level sheet orientation operation remains covered.
entries.recheckWhen: A sheet face reverse contract with valid options is documented.

entries.reason: The tested public imprint operation is rejected for a finite line against the generated sheet body.
entries.evidence: PK_BODY_imprint_curve returned error 914; no modified sheet fixture was retained.
entries.recheckWhen: A documented curve/sheet intersection and imprint contract is available.
